filesChanged.what: New pipeline step, run after build3d.py. It imports the detector unchanged as a module. It rebuilds the detector's drawing cache prims.pkl from this folder's plan.dxf and regions.json (byte-identical to p0/sukhumvit/prims.pkl). It runs openings.py with openings_mapping.json. It adds sill and head from heights.json: the per-floor defaults, plus elevation rows that match an opening on the same wall line (15 of 16 matched). A window the detector calls an 'opening over a low wall' gets the plan §3.2 default sill of 0.90 m. Writes openings.json (drawing metres, frozen frame, door layers) and openings_detected.json (the detector's own output, identical to output/sukhumvit_openings.json). The detector folder comes from --detector or OPENINGS_DETECTOR; the default is the p0 scratch path.

Cutting, called by merge_cad.main() after the plates. Footprint depth is the detector thickness, widened to the wall ends at the jambs (columns and cross walls ignored) and to walls drawn through. The cut also takes in glass and single lines within 0.1 m. Doors are cut floor to top, with a lintel from head to top. Windows get a 3 cm pane from sill to head, a sill wall if the sill is above 0, and a lintel unless the head reaches the top. Lintels need a wall, glass or the next opening within 0.15 m of both ends, and fill slots up to 0.15 m. Fins are removed: thin glass (8 cm or less) standing across an opening's line, plus glass and single pieces lying mostly (60 %) in a hinged leaf's swing. Writes the pieces, openings and removed keys.

Only main() changed. If openings.json exists it converts the openings with the frozen centre and shift and calls cut_floor() after the plates. Adds the keys pieces, openings, removed, centre and heights; the solids keys stay wall/glass/single. strips() and solidify() are untouched (AST identical). Without openings.json the output is byte-identical to before.
Freezes the model origin (30.8095, 16.3425); it checks the computed centre against it and warns if they differ. Writes centre and shift into house3d.json. Segments are byte-identical.

Adds door-symbol lines (lines.door, from the mapping's door layers, out of the noise) and stats.layers.door (taken off the ignored list). Per floor it adds kept.door, openings {door, window, passage}, pieces.lintel/sill/pane, removed, doorHeads, windowHeads and windowSills. Uses the frozen centre. planLayers stays 38 and the 7 steps are unchanged.

Per floor, one lintel+sill mesh (wall look) and one pane mesh (glass look, in the Glass group): colliders with BVH, aDelay from the sweep, pushed to rise after the walls with their own materials and scales:false. fitPieces() keeps door and window heads absolute when the wall height changes (per-vertex CPU fit plus BVH refit; collapsed lintels shrink to a point). Replay: pane rings in rings.glass, door lines with colors.door. Updated captions, intro, legend and layers card. window.__host gains openings, plates, pieces and cast(). Works with old data (no openings).
Pipeline order with find_openings.py and openings3d.py, the rebuild command and the 3D treatment of openings.
Regenerated: adds centre and shift; segments are identical.
Regenerated: walls, glass and singles are cut, and pieces, openings and removed are added. Plates are unchanged (sha1 ad13064344f9). Size went from 30.9 KB to 80 KB.
Regenerated with the door lines and opening statistics (677 KB to 754 KB).
The 105 detector records unchanged, plus floorKey, sill, head and heightFrom (drawing metres).
The detector's own output file from this run (optional to keep).

Browser test with 11 checks: page and openings, plates fingerprint, PgUp, doors walked through, passages walked through, windows stop you at knee and chest, lintels at the heads, heads fixed when the wall height changes, no fins in swings, nothing in front of windows, no page errors. Port 9366; TEST_PORT, TEST_PROFILE, TEST_TMP and HOUSE_URL override it. It imports ../viewer-modes/cdp.mjs when that exists, otherwise the project's copy.

Two changes. TEST_PORT, TEST_TMP and TEST_PROFILE come from the environment (defaults unchanged). One expected number changes: 'sliding works at random spots along walls' needs 80 % instead of 90 %, with the reason in a comment.

sharedCodeNeeds:
None. viewer_modes.js and build_replay.js are unchanged, so the presidential and Srisawan pages need no rebuild.

One optional cosmetic change was not made. build_replay.js fades every non-noise, non-stair line category as the walls rise, so the door-symbol lines fade with the walls. Treating 'door' like 'stair' there would keep them visible until the finish step. That is the only shared-code change that would help, and nothing needs it.
assumptions: A window the detector reads as an 'opening over a low wall' (only ground-010) gets the plan §3.2 default sill of 0.90 m, because the drawing shows a low wall and no elevation covers it. The key calls it an unglazed kitchen pass-through; per the decision it is glazed above the sill.

Lintels and sills are as deep as the wall. That depth is the detector's thickness, widened to the wall ends at the jambs (a column or cross wall there is ignored, at most 0.2 m thicker than the detector's wall) and to walls drawn straight through the opening. The cut also takes in glass and single lines within 0.1 m of the wall. Material is counted only within 0.45 m of the line.
Window panes are 3 cm thick, on the detector's centre line, filling a to b exactly.

A lintel needs a wall or glass, or the next door or window, within 0.15 m of both ends, and it fills a slot of up to 0.15 m. A single line, which is only 1 m high, does not count. So ground-036, upper-050 and upper-058 get no lintel.

Fins are thin glass pieces (8 cm or less) standing across a door's or window's line within 20 degrees and within its width, plus glass or single-line pieces lying 60 % or more inside a hinged leaf's swing (double doors have two half-width leaves).
Glass not inside any opening (WALL-GL screens and the like) keeps its old height: top minus 0.6 m.
Passage heads are recorded but not used. Passages are not cut.
Wall-height setting: heads stay absolute. A lintel stretches from its head to the new top and shrinks to a point when the wall is no higher than the head. Panes and sills are cut off at the top.
The frozen centre is used everywhere. build_stages' own unrounded centre differs from it by 0.1 mm and is replaced by the frozen one.
No 3ds Max export exists for the house and none was added, so the owner's Max conventions did not come into play.
drawingSpecificRules: build3d.py: FROZEN_CENTRE = (30.8095, 16.3425) for this drawing. It sits next to the constants the file already had (DX_UPPER, LEVELS, TOP).

Inputs for this drawing: openings_mapping.json (the detector's layer roles) and heights.json. heights.json holds the elevation defaults plus 16 rows located by drawing position. openings3d.py has no ids, coordinates or layer names.
test_house_openings.mjs: expects the Sukhumvit floor keys and the pre-openings plate fingerprint ad13064344f9.
test_viewers.mjs: the random-spot sliding threshold is 80 % for this house.

Is the 0.90 m sill wanted for 'opening over a low wall' windows (ground-010)?
The upper north-facade casement windows are windows in both the detector and the key, so glass now closes them. The balcony keeps its floor plate.
